description: Experience spec seed for business-health, authored as spike page 2/3 for the scenario-experience-spec/v1 vocabulary. Only the flagship Matrix page is specced; the remaining routes (/, /fleet, /wizard, /findings, /settings) are deliberate coverage debt for the experience-manager parser to surface. The Matrix spec is written to INTENT, not to the current build: the operator verdict is that the current UX is directionally correct but unpolished, so several machine-tier claims are expected to fail reconciliation — that expected-failure list is the calibration test that experience-manager detects real issues (see x-spike in pages/matrix.json).
